scenario: Devon worked 30 weeks as a salaried employee during the last 52 weeks, then was laid off. None of those weeks were self-employed work. He applies for Unemployment Insurance.
policy: An applicant is eligible for Unemployment Insurance only if they have worked at least 26 weeks in the preceding 52-week period. Weeks worked while self-employed do not count toward the 26-week requirement.
question: Is Devon eligible for Unemployment Insurance?
